remarks: Motivated landlord!! Bring me an offer! Walk to Harbor Point: Quiet rear unit! Welcome to this beautifully remodeled first-floor apartment just 2 minutes walk from Stamford RR for a quick commute to Manhattan!  Enjoy a bright and airy living space with ample natural light throughout. The full bath comes with a tub with shower attachment and a window for ventilation! The bedroom has a closet. The living Room faces the rear of the property and has an oversized window. Enjoy the renovated Eat-In Kitchen which is equipped with new appliances, ideal for cooking and dining.  Extras: Coin-operated Laundry: washer and dryer available in the shared lower level. Additional storage space directly outside the unit. One dedicated spot in the driveway behind the house. Tenant pays $200 per month for heat, hot water, cooking gas, and electricity (lights and window a/c units).  Tenant should have a stable work history and earn 2.5 times the monthly rent. Strong credit history required. Maximum of two occupants; no pets allowed.  Ready to make this your new home? Schedule your tour today and experience the charm and convenience of this lovely apartment!
